name: Work Breakdown Structure
description: A document model for creating and managing work breakdown structures

global.schema:
type WorkBreakdownStructureState {
  id: OID!
  title: String
  description: String
  budget: Float
  timeline: String
  tasks: [WBSTask!]!
  teamMembers: [TeamMember!]!
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime
}

type WBSTask {
  id: OID!
  parentTaskId: OID
  code: String!
  title: String!
  summary: String
  description: String
  status: TaskStatus!
  priority: TaskPriority!
  progress: Int
  estimatedHours: Int
  actualHours: Int
  startDate: DateTime
  dueDate: DateTime
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime
}

type TeamMember {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  email: String
  role: String
  avatar: String
  isActive: Boolean!
  joinedAt: DateTime!
}

enum TaskStatus {
  SCOPING
  TODO
  IN_PROGRESS
  REVIEW
  DONE
  BLOCKED
  CANCELLED
}

enum TaskPriority {
  LOW
  MEDIUM
  HIGH
  STRETCH
  CRITICAL
}

operations.name: CREATE_WBS
operations.description: Create a new work breakdown structure

operations.name: UPDATE_WBS_INFO
CREATE_TASK
operations.schema:
input CreateTaskInput {
  id: OID!
  parentTaskId: OID
  code: String!
  title: String!
  summary: String
  description: String
  status: TaskStatus!
  priority: TaskPriority!
  estimatedHours: Int
  startDate: DateTime
  dueDate: DateTime
  createdAt: DateTime!
}

output CreateTaskOutput {
  id: OID!
}
